subject: Initial privacy/consent/regulatory baseline complete
body: Initial Canadian privacy/regulatory baseline completed against BenefitFlow Beta v0.3.0. Core finding: production needs a first-class privacy authorization layer separate from booking approval. Current synthetic beta stores raw plan/member identifiers in generic SQLite JSON state and has no consent ledger, retention/privacy-rights layer, processor registry, or breach/audit model. Recommended production gate: PRIV-001 through PRIV-006 before accepting real personal data. Federal PIPEDA remains current; Bill C-36 is a pending reform proposal. Provincial integration modes (BC PIPA, Alberta PIPA/HIA, Ontario PHIPA, Quebec private-sector law) should be jurisdiction-aware.
recommended_next_action: Primary/reviewer triage PRIV-001 through PRIV-006 and preserve synthetic-only data boundary until those controls are accepted or explicitly waived.
